# Model




```{r}
ordinal_classifier <- nn_module(
  "ordinal_classifier",
  initialize = function(c=NULL){
    self$c <- c
    #browser()
    # self$gene_names
    self$layers <- nn_sequential(
      nn_dropout(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 33694L, out_features = 3072L), nn_tanh(), #
      nn_linear(in_features = 3072L, out_features = 2048L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 2048L, out_features = 1024L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 1024L, out_features = 1L)
    ) 
  },
  
  forward = function(x){
    x |> self$layers()
  },
  
  step = function(){
    ctx$pred <- ctx$input |> self$forward()
    
    opt <- ctx$optimizers[[1]]
    ctx$loss <- list(ordinalReg_loss=nnf_ordinal_regression_loss(ctx$pred, ctx$target, c = self$c))
    
    if (ctx$training){
      #browser()
      opt$zero_grad()
      ctx$loss[[1]]$backward()
      opt$step()
    }
     #ctx$loss[[1]] <- loss$detach()
  }
)
```

```{r prados_delayed_ds}

delayed_ds <- dataset(
  name = "sce_dataset",
 
  initialize = function(x,y) {
    self$x <- x;self$y <- y
    stopifnot(identical(length(y),nrow(x)))
  },
 
  .length = function() {length(self$y)},
 
  .getbatch = function(index) { list(
    x = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$x[index, ,drop=FALSE]), torch_float()),
    y = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$y[index], ncol=1), torch_float())
  )},
 
  .getitem = function(index) {
    if (is.list(index)) {index <- unlist(index)}
    self$.getbatch(index)
  }
)
```



```{r}
train_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(train)), y=as.numeric(train$BraakStage))
```

       dimnames = list(c("1", "2", "3"),

```{r}
nnf_ordinal_regression_loss <- function(pred,target,c=NULL){
  # combinations
  #browser()
  ij <- torch_combinations(torch_arange(1,length(pred), dtype = torch_long()))
  # margin ranking loss
  l <- nnf_margin_ranking_loss(input1 = pred[ij[,1]], input2= pred[ij[,2]], target = sign(target[ij[,1]] - target[ij[,2]]),
                               reduction = "none",margin = 1)
  
  #browser()
  if (!is.null(c)){
    # matrix
    m <- cbind(as_array(ij), as_array(pred[ij[,1]]), as_array(pred[ij[,2]]), as_array(target[ij[,1]]),
             as_array(target[ij[,2]]) ,as_array(l))
    # removing equal predictions
    #browser()
    m <- m[-which(m[,5]==m[,6]),]
    pj <- as.integer(m[,4]); tj <- as.integer(m[,6])
    ind <- which(pj==0)
    if (length(ind)>=1) pj[ind] <- 1
    # f <- function(x,y){
    #   if(x==0) x<-x+1
    #   p <- torch_diag(c[m[,c(4,6)][,1], m[,c(4,6)][,2]])
    # }
    # p <- unlist(Map(f, m[,4], m[,6]))[[1]]
    # gathering cost values for predicted values
    p <- torch_diag(c[pj, tj])
    #browser()
    # weighted loss
    loss <- torch_tensor(torch_mean(m[,7]*p), requires_grad = TRUE)
  } else {loss <- l$mean()}
  
}
```



```{r}
nn_ordinal_regression_loss <- nn_module(
  "nn_ordinal_regression_loss",
  initialize = function(c=NULL){
    self$c <- c
  },
  forward = function(input, target){
    nnf_ordinal_regression_loss(input, target, c = self$c)
  }
  
)
```
